senses.gloss:
Peralakṣetramāhātmya
from Brahmakaivartapurāṇa. adhys. 299-303. IO. 6637. Mack 76.

Peralasthalamāhātmya
on Peralam in Tanjore district. from Skandapurāṇa. Burnell 196a (2 mss.). TD. 10173. 10174.

Peralīyamāhātmya
See Prābhākarakṣetrapraśam3sā from Bhaviṣyatpurāṇa, TD. 10030.
Noticed a. Paralīvaidyanāthamāhātmya in Burnell 190b.

Periyappā_Kavi
son of Patañjalasūri alias Aṇṇāśāstrin an. Lakṣmī an. grandson [Page196-b] of Kṛṣṇa; contemporary of Rāmabhadra Dīkṣita.
--Śṛṅgāramañjarīśāharājīya. on a love theme pertaining to king Śāhaji. MT. 1843.
--joint a. of Ṣaḍdarśanasiddhāntasaṅgraha. TD. 7631. Pt.. Tanjore Sar. Mah. Ser. 171. 1980.
See Śāhendravilāsa intro. p. 44 an. NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 96.

Perudīkṣita
son of Lakṣmaṇārya of Paṭṭasa family.
--C. Mantrakairava on Devīmāhātmya. MT. 2563.

Perundevīstuti
or Devarājamahiṣīstotra. 5 verses (Beg. zrIkAJcIpurahastizailanilaye) on goddess Lakṣmī a. Kanchi.
Adyar I. p. 201b. Adyar D. IV. 2441-2. MD. 9767. Taylor I. p. 287.

Perundevīstotra
in Āryā metre. (Beg. vande padAravindaM). on consort of Varadarāja. Adyar II. p. 8b (2 mss.). Adyar D. IV. 2443 (33 verses). MD. 11424 (inc.). 11425 (inc.). 14598 (inc.). MT. 1031 (c) (93 verses). Taylor II. p. 9 (65 verses).
See Adyar Library Bulletin IV. 1. Mss. notes p.. 17-18.

Perubhaṭṭa
alias Perama Bhaṭṭa; father an. preceptor of Jagannātha Paṇḍita (a. of Rasagaṅgādhara etc.); pupil of Jñānendra Bhikṣu, Mahendra Khaṇḍadeva an. Śeṣa Vīreśvara. See Rasagaṅgādhara I. 2-3.

Perusūri
grandfather of Perusūri (a. of Vasumaṅgalanāṭaka, MD. 12659).

Perusūri
of Kauśikagotra; had the title Abhinavapatañjali; descendant of Śrīdhara; grandson of Perusūri; son of Veṅkaṭa an. Veṅkaṭā; disciple of Vāsudeva Adhvarin identified with Vāsudeva Dkṣita, a of C. on [Page197-a. Siddhāntakaumudī an. hence date given a. 1703-1743 A. D. See Yudhisthira Mimamsak, Sam3skṛta Vyākaraṇ Śāstra kā Itihās II. p.. 194-5.
--Auṇādikapadārṇava. Pt.. Mad. Uni. Skt. Ser. 7. 1939.
--Cakorasandeśa. TD. 3863.
--Bharatābhyudaya. mentioned in his Vasumaṅgalanāṭaka.
--Rāmacandravijaya. kāvya. Mysore N. D. VIII. 26435. Extr. p. 146.
--Vasumaṅgalanāṭaka. MD. 12659.
--Veṅkaṭabhāṇa. mentioned in his Vasumaṅgalanāṭaka.

Perūrsthalapurāṇa
See Ādipuramāhātmya, NCC. II. p. 83a.
